WoW: Forever

Protection Warrior

Shield tanking, and one of Forever's three tanks. The shield is also a Rage engine now, which makes Protection the spec both guide sites recommend for levelling a Warrior.

WoW: Forever · Tank · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

Guide to the live game, levels 1 to 60. The talent order is Icy Veins' published Protection levelling build (page dated November 4), checked against the live tree. Level-60 builds are Icy Veins' and Wowhead's, named where they differ. Numbers are the client's unless a source is named. Anything marked (WoWSims' model) is what a simulator's rotation list does at 60, not a measured result. Its threat figures are measured from combat logs and are named as measurements. No raid is open until December 9, so raid tanking is untested. Hover tooltips can show the wrong rank, so where one differs from the prose, believe the prose.

What Protection is for

Taking hits and turning them into Rage and threat. Shield SpecializationShield SpecializationTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block. at 5/5 returns 5 Rage on every block, where Classic gave 1. Master of DefenseMaster of DefenseTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantGrants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped. does the same on every Dodge and Parry. That Rage pays for RevengeRevengeLevel 14 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost5 RageRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownInstantly counterattack an enemy for (20 + 22.5% of attack power) to (24 + 22.5% of attack power) damage and a high amount of threat. Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry., which was rebuilt as a damage button.

It levels well, and the sources say so in strong terms. Icy Veins: "Protection is the fastest Warrior specialization for leveling in WoW Forever and the one we recommend." Wowhead: Arms and Fury Warriors "will be looking to Protection for the first 35-40 levels". Both name the same limits: a slow start before Shield BlockShield BlockLevel 16 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost10 RageCooldown5 sec cooldownDuration7 secIncreases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks. at 16, and trouble with casters and elementals, whose attacks cannot be blocked. Kargoz argues the other side: a shield is safer than dungeons need, and Arms kills faster. That is one creator's report.

Threat is yours to hold. Blessing of Salvation was removed (Blizzard), so damage dealers have no blessing to shed threat with. Defensive StanceDefensive StanceLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown1 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledA defensive combat stance. Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%. Increases all threat generated by 80%. adds 80% to all threat you generate (Blizzard, live November 4), and DefianceDefianceTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 20% while a shield is equipped. adds up to 20% more with a shield. The two multiply (WoWSims' reading of the client).

The Rage rework favours Protection (ours, not a source's). Armor you wear does not reduce Rage from taking damage: the formula assumes 20% to 40% mitigation for your level. One limit: a hit blocked in full gives no Rage from damage taken (WoWSims' measurement). The two block talents are what pay you for it.

Wowhead notes it is your hardest hit below 20% health but needs Battle or Berserker Stance, so do not swap with a full Rage bar or under heavy damage.

Stat priority

While levelling: the best one-hander you can get, a shield, then Strength and Stamina. Wowhead's levelling page: Rage is normalized, so take the higher-level weapon, and between two equal weapons take the faster one.

At 60 both sites give more than one list, because tank gear is a trade between threat and survival.

  • Icy Veins, offensive: Expertise, Hit, Agility, Strength, Stamina. Defensive: Stamina, Armor, Agility, Dodge and Parry, Defense. It puts Defense last because Shield BlockShield BlockLevel 16 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost10 RageCooldown5 sec cooldownDuration7 secIncreases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks. already keeps ordinary melee crits off you.
  • Wowhead, balanced: Stamina, Expertise to 6.5%, Hit to 8%, Defense to 440, then Expertise to 14%, Armor, Strength, Agility. It also publishes a defensive and an offensive list and says to start from the balanced one.

The two disagree on Defense: Wowhead wants 440 early, Icy Veins ranks it last. Neither has raid data yet. Expertise is a new stat in Forever; 6.5% removes a boss's dodges and 14% its parries from the front (both sites).

Strength raises block value as well as Attack Power, and Shield SlamShield SlamTalent · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost20 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownSlam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat. uses block value twice (WoWSims' measurement). ClassicWoW.gg's beta-era page says Hit gear also makes TauntTauntLevel 10 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown8 sec cooldownDuration3 secTaunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you. more reliable; nothing newer confirms it.

At level 60

Dungeons are the level-60 game until raids open on December 9. Both sites publish a shield build ending in Shield SlamShield SlamTalent · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost20 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownSlam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat., above. Wowhead also describes two builds without a deep Protection tree: a Fury and Protection hybrid (3/31/17) that keeps a shield and takes Death WishDeath WishTalentCastInstantCost10 RageCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration30 secWhen activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec., FlurryFlurryTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike. and BloodthirstBloodthirstLevel 40 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost30 RageRangeMeleeCooldown6 sec cooldownDuration10 secInstantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec., and a pure dual-wield build for enemies whose attacks cannot be blocked. It rates the hybrid a low single-digit damage gain unless you ExecuteExecuteLevel 24 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost15 RageRangeMeleeAttempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 125 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 3 additional damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health. in Berserker StanceBerserker StanceLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCooldown1 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAn aggressive stance. Critical strike chance increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 10%., and warns the dual-wield build takes about 50% more damage on a normal boss. Its author adds that endgame tuning is unknown: if bosses hit harder than Classic's, the builds will change. No raid log exists yet.
